on-error-propagate.doc:name: Transient Errors
on-error-propagate.type: RETRY_EXHAUSTED, HTTP:TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, HTTP:INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, HTTP:BAD_GATEWAY, HTTP:SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, HTTP:TIMEOUT, HTTP:CONNECTIVITY, SFTP:CONNECTIVITY

logger.doc:name: Log Transient Error
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: 'Transient error. Watermark not advanced; the same window will be retried on the next scheduled run.', correlationId: vars.correlationId default correlationId, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default ''), description: error.description, failedWindowStart: vars.lastRunTime default '' }]

logger.doc:name: Log Non-Retryable Error
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), message: 'Non-retryable error. Watermark not advanced; the run will repeat and fail until the cause is fixed.', correlationId: vars.correlationId default correlationId, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default ''), description: error.description, failedWindowStart: vars.lastRunTime default '' }]
